verdict.rationale: Clerk documents first-party session lifecycle management with "active device monitoring and session revocation", and its user profile UI shows a per-device "Sign out of device" action. That covers users viewing their devices and revoking them individually. The evidence does not show an admin-facing view of a user's sessions or a revoke-all action, so only part of the story is evidenced. missing for 10: admin-side session/device visibility and revocation, bulk "revoke all sessions" capability, in-depth docs or API references for session listing/revocation, independent or hands-on corroboration
